name: Editorial neutral
description: Calm editorial illustration with restrained color and generous space.
visualRules: Simple shapes, balanced horizontal composition, muted neutral palette, clear subject hierarchy. No decorative objects.

name: Clean diagram
description: Clear visual explanation of a process or relationship.
visualRules: Only the entities and connections named in the brief. Clear spacing and directional flow. No text labels or invented steps.

name: Balanced comparison
description: Two-sided comparison with equal visual weight.
visualRules: Exactly the compared subjects from the brief, with symmetric layout and a quiet neutral background. No unsupported differences or labels.
